jobs.title: 2026 Venture Associate/Sr. Associate (Healthcare)
jobs.description:
Based in our Menlo Park /San Francisco office, the successful candidate will support the healthcare/biotech investment team by taking part in the identification, origination, evaluation, diligence, and negotiation of new investment opportunities. They will also participate in portfolio management activities including quarterly valuation, exit strategy and strategic assistance to individual companies, as necessary.

Doc Jobs candidates- please submit your information to learn more.
